main.summary: Transport-neutral DataControl wake notification emitted by the service and consumed by clients to shorten follow and resume latency without replacing canonical state refresh.

property.name: AppendedLength
property.summary: Total durable appended length associated with the notification, when known.

property.name: EventType
property.summary: Notification event type describing why the client should wake and reconcile current transfer state.

property.name: ItemID
property.summary: Immutable item identifier associated with the notification, when known.

property.name: LatestRange
property.summary: Latest realized or appended range associated with the notification, when known.

property.name: Mode
property.summary: Transfer mode associated with the notification, when known.

property.name: RealizedBytes
property.summary: Total realized bytes associated with the notification, when known.

property.name: Sequence
property.summary: Monotonic notification sequence value scoped by the eventual publisher implementation.

property.name: SessionID
property.summary: Transfer session identifier associated with the notification, when known.

property.name: SourceSessionID
property.summary: Source transfer session identifier used by follow and resume workflows, when known.

property.name: StateVersion
property.summary: Transfer state version associated with the notification, when known.

property.name: Status
property.summary: Transfer status associated with the notification, when known.

property.name: Timestamp
property.summary: Timestamp describing when the notification was created.

property.name: TransferFamily
property.summary: Transfer family associated with the notification, when known.
